cover_note: I ran a warehouse migration and the analytics roadmap alongside finance and engineering partners, which is the combination your Senior Program Manager role asks for. The migration work taught me how to keep a multi-team cutover honest: a schedule the teams believe, risks raised early, and a plan that survives the week it actually ships. The roadmap work taught me the rest, which is translating platform trade-offs into language finance and engineering can both act on. At Acme Analytics those jobs were really the same job, and I would expect them to be the same job at ExampleCo. I would start by listening to where the current migration hurts, then make the plan boring again.
